# Ashikul Bari Chowdhury — Portfolio

> Cyber Security Analyst and GRC Specialist | Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

## About

Ashikul Bari Chowdhury is a Cyber Security Analyst and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Specialist currently pursuing a **Master of Cyber Security at La Trobe University**, Melbourne, Victoria, Australia (2026–2028).

He holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering from North South University, Dhaka, Bangladesh (2020–2025) and serves as **Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Reevolt**, where he directs strategic operations, manages project deliverables, and leads cross-functional development teams.

He is **actively seeking GRC Analyst, SOC Analyst, Information Security Analyst, Compliance Analyst, and Cybersecurity Graduate roles** in Melbourne, Victoria, and across Australia — including remote and hybrid positions.
